thread:
Ryan Park: quick sync — we need a minimal set of continuous batching metrics for the new console panels. thinking: batch_size_hist (per-model, per-region), batch_wait_ms_p50/p95, queue_saturation, fill_rate. any runtime/infra constraints?
Maya Chen: +1. also surface "batch_type" (sync/async) and per-route priority tags. small messages: can we get percentiles for wait time too? p50/p95/p99
Pradeep Rao: worried about cardinality. model+route+region+priority+batch_type explodes. propose pre-aggregations: per-model and per-route top-level, sampled detailed histograms for high-traffic models only.
Ryan Park: good call. what sampling criteria? maybe top 20 models by qps + explicit opt-in flag.
Zoe Alvarez: we need to attach trace_id and request_id exemplars to histogram buckets for slow tails. also instrument dispatcher latency as a timed metric.
Maya Chen: dispatch latency metric name: runtime.dispatch.latency_ms; histogram buckets: [1,2,5,10,25,50,100,250,500,1000]
Ryan Park: snippet of proposed Prometheus labels:
```
runtime.batch_size_hist{model_id="gpt-small",region="us-west-2",route="/chat",priority="standard",batch_type="sync"}
runtime.batch_wait_ms_bucket{...}
```
Pradeep Rao: we should push pre-aggregated counters to statsd for daily rollups. If we keep histogram buckets coarse at exporter, downstream can compute finer percentiles via exemplars.
Lia Morales: for console UX we want a simple "Saturation" gauge per model and an alert when sustained > 75% for 5m. can teams provide the numerator/denominator? (occupied_slots/total_capacity)
Ryan Park: runtime can export occupied_slots and configured_capacity per pool; need naming: pool_id, hardware_tier
Maya Chen: action items:
- Pradeep: sketch pre-agg windowing + sampling policy (due Thu) @Pradeep
- Ryan: add exemplar wiring + metric names to runtime PR (due Fri)
- Zoe: dashboard panels + alert thresholds (WIP, due next Tue)
- Lia: draft UX copy for saturation card (due next Tue)
ops-bot: deploy scheduled: dashboard-metrics-ingest v2 will land in staging at 2024-11-15T07:00Z :rocket:
Ryan Park: thanks — will follow up in the RFC thread. feel free to ping here for infra constraints.
